text.card: A star about 33 parsecs away, 1.1 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.1 solar radii and 1.02 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,876 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 23079
quotes.card: HD 23079, also named Tupi, is a star in the southern constellation of Reticulum.
quotes.introduction: Since the star has an apparent visual magnitude of 7.12, it is not visible to the naked eye, but at least in binoculars it should be easily visible.
